summary: Iter63 spreadsheet import (Team Hub kinds) - Backend: 27/27 pytest cases pass. Verified template GET (csv+xlsx) for roster/team_sizes/team_paperwork/team_payments plus non-team 'expenses' still works. Preview shapes verified: roster returns existing_teams; team_sizes/team_paperwork return columns/rows/existing_members; team_payments returns amount_paid/method/paid_on/paid + existing_members. Commit paths verified: roster CREATES then UPDATES same-named member (no duplicate, id retained) and auto-creates unknown teams; team_sizes appends columns to shared sheet and fills values; team_paperwork creates a NEW sheet with sheet_name; team_payments creates a NEW tracker with tracker_amount and per-member entries. 403 gating confirmed: user WITHOUT team_access is blocked on preview & commit for all 4 team kinds while 'expenses' preview still works for them. Frontend: login with applereview succeeded, roster-import-spreadsheet / sizes-import / paperwork-import / payments-import all present and navigate to /import/{kind}. Pick stage renders download-template-btn + pick-file-btn. Privacy Policy screen renders with both new 'Team Hub' and 'Uploaded files' sections and no red-screen errors. All TEST_ data created during testing was cleaned up; applereview retained team_access=true (verified via /auth/me post-cleanup). Temporary no-access user was also deleted.
critical_code_review_comments: imports.py roster commit uses `created += 1` for BOTH new and updated members which double-counts as 'created' in the success screen. Consider tracking updated separately (e.g. return {created, updated, skipped}). Not a bug, just misleading UX copy.

imports.py roster update path only sets fields where `if v` is truthy — this means clearing a field via re-import (e.g. removing a phone number) is not possible. Acceptable for MVP but worth documenting.

Frontend /import/[kind].tsx hardcodes 'Imported Paperwork' / 'Imported Payments' as default sheetName in state; if user clears the input the client sends undefined and backend defaults kick in — behavior is fine, just noting the split responsibility.
seed_data_creation: Created and DELETED: 1 temporary user (TEST_noaccess_*@example.com), 1 roster member 'TESTImport Person63', 1 team 'TEST_Team_ImportA', 2 size columns (TEST_Shirt63, TEST_Bow63), 1 paperwork sheet (TEST_Paperwork_*), 1 payment tracker (TEST_Payments_*). Cleanup test (test_zz_cleanup) runs last and verified applereview retains team_access=true.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_iter63_spreadsheet_import.py. They are idempotent and self-cleaning. Frontend upload flow (DocumentPicker) was not exercised end-to-end via Playwright because browser file picker isn't scriptable easily; instead we tested via curl/pytest which drives the same /api/import/preview + /api/import/commit endpoints the UI calls. All four Team Hub entry buttons and the /import/[kind] pick stage were verified in the browser.
